title: Marine Corps Community Services (MCCS) Officer (III) (CWO5 to WO) PMOS, DC M&RA
raw_text:
1. MOS 4130, Marine Corps Community Services (MCCS) Officer (III) (CWO5 to
WO) PMOS, DC M&RA

    a. Summary. MCCS Officers are responsible for myriad of MCCS duties
that include managerial staff functions and positions located above the
direct program managerial and operational level of individual MCCS programs.
MCCS Officers support planning, organizing, directing, coordinating, and
controlling the overall operations of MCCS. Duties consist of program,
fiscal, logistical, and other managerial functions that are required to
ensure oversight. Where authorized by policy, MCCS Officers also serve in
direct MCCS program support billets, such as Marine Corps Exchange
Supervisors and Managers. Duties include overseeing and managing daily
operations in both a deployed and a garrison environment.

       b.    Prerequisites

        (1) Must meet eligibility and appointment criteria as prescribed in
MCO 1040.42B, WO and LDO accession programs.

        (2) Evidence of prior achievement as indicated in the following order
of desirability:

            (a) Qualified in the exchange field as evidenced by having been
assigned and successfully serving in MOS 4133 for a minimum of 24 months.

            (b) A degree from an accredited institution in a retailing
related discipline such as human resource management, or business management.

            (c) Strong background in civilian retail management without a
degree, but with evidence of having completed three or more courses contained
in disciplines cited paragraph 1124.lb(2)(a) above.

    c. Requirements. Complete the Warrant Officer Basic Course (WOBC)
(M02RMN4) within 18 months of appointment to WO.

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (aw), Marine Corps Community Services Training and Readiness
Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
First-Line Supervisors/Managers of Retail Sales Workers 41-1011.

       f.    Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
